name: remove_item_from_cart
description: Removes a product line entirely from the authenticated user's cart on Carrefour France, whatever its quantity. Use this to delete an item: add_item_to_cart with counter 0 does not remove anything on Carrefour's side. Idempotent: removing a product that is not in the cart succeeds and changes nothing. Takes the product EAN, the basket service ID (the cart's facilityServiceId, shown by get_cart) and the sub-basket type (e.g. 'drive_clcv').

ean.description: The EAN (barcode) of the product to remove from the cart.

basketServiceId.description: The basket service ID of the cart line (the cart's facilityServiceId, e.g. '0678-150-7052').

subBasketType.description: The sub-basket type, e.g. 'drive_clcv' for drive click-and-collect.
